visualCharacteristics.purpose: linked product / service cards in a 3-column grid
visualCharacteristics.description: No existing cards variants in blocks/. White bordered cards on grey, 3 per row, centered contained product image (not cropped), centered light-weight title, description + bullet list, whole card clickable.

contentPattern.summary: 7 linked product/service cards in a wrapping 3-column grid
contentPattern.structure: two cells: (1) product image (contained, centered, not cropped), (2) title heading wrapping a link to the detail page, a description paragraph and a bulleted feature list; the title link makes the whole card clickable

cells: Title heading (linked) + description paragraph + bulleted list

reuseGuidance: Use for product series / category listings that link to detail pages. For text-only boxes use cards-faq.
usageDescription: Grid of product or service cards, each with an image, a linked title, a short description and a feature list. The whole card links to the title link target.
